title: RAG fixture file
description: Evaluation cases with literal evidence anchors. The tool reads this file from the head commit of a pull request and verifies that every anchor still resolves.

version.description: Schema version. Unknown versions are rejected.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the file. Used in reports and CI annotations.

question.description: The evaluation question. Shown in reports so reviewers can judge the change.

evidence.description: Literal anchors. An empty array is allowed but nothing can be verified for the case.

path.description: Repo-relative path using forward slashes. Absolute paths, backslashes, colons, empty segments, '.' and '..' segments are rejected.

exact.description: Literal text that must appear in the file. Matching is byte-exact after CRLF normalization; no case folding, no whitespace folding.

prefix.description: Optional literal text immediately before 'exact'. Used to disambiguate repeated quotes. An empty string means no constraint.

suffix.description: Optional literal text immediately after 'exact'. Used to disambiguate repeated quotes. An empty string means no constraint.
